subject: 藏地毛织布棚市场摊（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw the attached Tibetan market stall with the same tan cloth, four wood posts, folded cloth, sacks, jars and restrained realistic materials. ONLY CHANGE its proportions and camera: reduce front counter/wide ground edge, increase depth so two ground axis lengths are in 5:4 ratio, a nearly square ground plan. Current wide front is too stretched; do NOT copy that ratio. Orthographic exact 2:1 dimetric, no perspective. Footprint visible corners as proportions of canvas: LEFT(0.18,0.63), FRONT(0.5356,0.8078), RIGHT(0.82,0.6656), BACK(0.4644,0.4878). BOTH ground edges slopes exactly +0.5/-0.5. Keep all four posts vertical. Do not label points. Image single small roadside stall, south-facing opening lower-left. True transparent RGBA background preserving alpha; all solid objects opaque, no glow or halo. Light upper left, tiny contact shadow lower right. Leave full transparent margin and retain the full outline. No writing, no people, no animals, modern objects, white background, grid or checkerboard. No thick raised presentation plinth.

prior.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create exactly ONE isolated city-map sprite for tianshu, historical Tibetan regional kit. Realistic ancient material detail and crisp restrained weathering matching the attached Song reference; reinterpret the subject in Tibetan stone/wood/cloth construction, not Chinese gray-tiled gables. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, yaw45 pitch30, NO perspective convergence. BOTH ground axes MUST form exactly slopes +0.5 and -0.5 in screen space, opposite edges parallel, upright vertical posts. The ground-plane bounding diamond must be twice as wide as high. Thin natural ground contact, clearly visible LEFT, FRONT and RIGHT ground corners; no thick display slab. South/front faces screen lower left. Opaque solid object with real RGBA background transparency; no luminous rim, haze, glow, baked white or checkerboard. Warm-neutral light from screen UPPER LEFT, tiny short soft contact shadow lower right. Entire asset centered with at least10% transparent margins, no cropping. No people, animals, writing, marks resembling lettering, shop signs, watermark, labels, grid, modern elements, background scenery, road, sky, floating island, diorama base, cartoon or toy. Original generic regional adaptation; not a named historical monument. Asset ID bld_kit_tubo_market_stall. One Tibetan market canopy on a 5m east-west by4m north-south rectangle, ground east-west edge exactly1.25 times north-south. Low, stretched coarse tan woolen cloth canopy with a nearly flat roof and slightly sagging edge, supported by four weathered wooden posts and thin crossbeams. A low trestle counter underneath, folded brown and ochre cloth, tied burlap grain sacks and two earthenware jars. Modest gray stone post pads, thin compacted-earth footprint. No walls, flags, prayer text or outside props. Keep the full support feet and thin footprint corners visible. Low structure, do not invent a multi-building market square.
